relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: For the mPFC of SNI male mice, the most noticeable signatures included downregulation of Mal (myelin and lymphocyte protein), Mbp (myelin basic protein), and Cnp

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: downregulation of Col3a1 and Col1a1, two transcripts that encode type I and type III collagens

key_findings: SNI-induced transcriptomic changes in mPFC and ACC at 2 weeks were largely sex- and region-specific: female ACC more affected (extracellular matrix de-enriched), male mPFC more affected (myelin genes down).
Baseline differences between regions and sexes may contribute to the SNI-induced differences.
